RUBRIC · 85 REPORT POINTS

Section-by-section assessment

Open a section for its rubric, original AI assessment, source references and editable human marks. A missing or unasked item remains pending, rather than silently becoming zero.

440-question alignment · applicability and answer support

This is an internal analytics design bank. Project evidence, portfolio records, institutional sources and external requirements are distinct. Question coverage is separate from the CII score. A badge does not supply missing answers.

Scoring benchmarks, sustainability and badge policy
ORIGINAL STUDENT ANSWERS

Complete detailed report

Every saved answer and nested row is retained. Attendance is calculated for each person against the configured requirement, with invalid entries shown separately.

ORIGINALS + LABELLED SUPPLEMENTAL FILES

Evidence review & manual marks

Public, restricted and private labels remain attached. Authorised Admin review can access all originals; sharing permissions do not earn or remove marks.

Add review supporting evidence

Authorised supervisors or Admin may add images, video, PDF, documents or other records. New files retain their uploader and source; student originals are preserved. Adding evidence changes the packet revision and requires an updated analysis before approval.
